# Rhythm Recovery

Rhythm Recovery is a daily habit tracker for the first 90 days of recovery
and beyond. It pairs a fixed daily checklist (reading, prayer/meditation,
calls to a sponsor and fellowship, meeting attendance, journaling) with the
12 steps, giving people a place to track and keep that daily rhythm. It
does not promise or guarantee any recovery outcome.

Key facts:
- Not a social network: no feeds, no public profiles, no following.
- Identity is anonymous by default (auto-generated display name).
- Progress is shown as streaks and milestone badges (90 days, 6 months,
  9 months, 1 year, 18 months, then annually), not a public leaderboard.
- Users can optionally share a static snapshot (streak and milestone
  progress only, never journal entries or contact details) via SMS or
  email.
- Recovery and journal data are treated as sensitive personal data.

This site (rhythmrecovery.app) is a pre-launch landing page for early
access sign-ups. The product itself has not shipped yet.
